theorem mvcc.take_succ_getElem {α : Type} (l : List α) (i : Nat) (a : α) (h : l[i]? = some a) :
    List.take (i + 1) l = List.take i l ++ [a]

theorem mvcc.watchEvents_rev_ge (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo d : Nat) (ev : mvcc.EvM) :
    ev ∈ mvcc.watchEvents L r lo d → ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < d ∧ j < List.length L ∧ ev.kv.modRev = W64 ↑j

theorem mvcc.mem_entsOfRev (r : Nat) (b : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (e : mvcc.KvEnt) : e
    ∈ mvcc.entsOfRev r b cs ↔ ∃ i c kv, cs[i]? = some c ∧ mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑r) b cs i = some kv ∧
    e = { rev := { main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑i }, tomb := c.isDel, kv := kv }

theorem mvcc.mem_logEvents (log : mvcc.Log) (a b : Nat) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : ev ∈ mvcc.logEvents log a
    b ↔ ∃ j, a ≤ j ∧ j < b ∧ ev ∈ mvcc.evsOfRevM j (mvcc.stateAt log (j - 1)) (List.getD log j [])

theorem mvcc.revKey_ge (lo r i : Nat) (t : Bool) (hlo : lo < 2 ^ 64) (hr : r < 2 ^ 64) (hi : i < 2 ^
    64) : go.GoStringLe (mvcc.revBytes { main := W64 ↑lo, sub := W64 0 } false) (mvcc.revBytes {
    main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑i } t) ↔ lo ≤ r

theorem mvcc.ebFold_spec (F : List mvcc.EvM) (hs : mvcc.RevSorted F) : F = [] ∧ mvcc.ebFold F = none
    ∨ F ≠ [] ∧ ∃ B, mvcc.ebFold F = some B ∧ mvcc.ebInv F B

def mvcc.beVal : List w8 → Nat :=
  List.brecOn x✝ mvcc.beVal._f

theorem mvcc.combine_reverse (l : List w8) : LittleEndian.combine l.reverse = mvcc.beVal l

    mvcc.Change) (hr : cs = [] ∨ r ≠ W64 0) : mvcc.CrPos (mvcc.applyChanges r s cs)

    (mvcc.stateAt log (j - 1)) (List.getD log j [])) : j < List.length log ∧ e.rev.main = W64 ↑j

    < 2 ^ 63) (j : Nat) : (List.getD log j []).length < 2 ^ 63

theorem mvcc.logEnts_bounds (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List
    mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (lo hi : Nat) (hhi : hi ≤ List.length log) (e :
    mvcc.KvEnt) : e ∈ mvcc.logEnts log lo hi → 0 ≤ sint.Z e.rev.main ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z e.rev.sub

theorem mvcc.memberBatch_sublist (C : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length C < 2 ^ 63) (r :
    mvcc.WatchRange) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (evs : List mvcc.EvM) (hi : Nat) (hhi : hi ≤ List.length
    C) (hF : (List.filter (fun ev => r.covers ev.kv.key && decide (sint.Z st.minRev ≤ sint.Z
    ev.kv.modRev)) evs).Sublist (mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat st.minRev) hi)) : mvcc.memberBatch r
    st evs = none ∨ ∃ B, mvcc.memberBatch r st evs = some B ∧ B.evs ≠ [] ∧ (B.moreRev = W64 0 ∧
    B.evs.Sublist (mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat st.minRev) hi) ∨ ∃ M, B.moreRev = W64 ↑M ∧
    sint.nat st.minRev < M ∧ M < hi ∧ B.evs.Sublist (mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat st.minRev) M))

    go.GoStringLt x y

theorem mvcc.revBytes_split2 (a : mvcc.Rev) (t : Bool) : mvcc.revBytes a t = u64Be a.main ++ [W8 95]
    ++ (u64Be a.sub ++ if t = true then [W8 116] else [])

theorem mvcc.memberBatch_eq (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (evs : List mvcc.EvM) :
    mvcc.memberBatch r st evs = mvcc.ebFold (List.filter (fun ev => r.covers ev.kv.key && decide
    (sint.Z st.minRev ≤ sint.Z ev.kv.modRev)) evs)

theorem mvcc.bucketRange_logEnts (log : mvcc.Log) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' log) (hlen : List.length log <
    2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (lo hi : Nat) (hlohi :
    lo < 2 ^ 63) (hhi : hi ≤ List.length log) : mvcc.bucketRange (mvcc.bucketMap log) (mvcc.revBytes
    { main := W64 ↑lo, sub := W64 0 } false) (mvcc.revBytes { main := W64 ↑hi, sub := W64 0 } false)
    = List.map mvcc.KvEnt.pair (mvcc.logEnts log lo hi)

theorem mvcc.zipIdx_map_range {α β : Type} (l : List α) (d : α) (g : α × Nat → β) : List.map g
    l.zipIdx = List.map (fun i => g (l.getD i d, i)) (List.range l.length)

theorem mvcc.memberBatch_logEvents (C : mvcc.Log) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' C) (hlen : List.length C < 2 ^
    63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ C → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (st :
    mvcc.WatcherSt) (p : mvcc.EvM → Bool) (lo hi : Nat) (hp : ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), r.covers ev.kv.key
    = true → p ev = true) (hlo : ↑lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev) (hhi : hi ≤ List.length C) :
    mvcc.memberBatch r st (List.filter p (mvcc.logEvents C lo hi)) = none ∧ mvcc.watchEvents C r
    (sint.nat st.minRev) hi = [] ∨ ∃ B, mvcc.memberBatch r st (List.filter p (mvcc.logEvents C lo
    hi)) = some B ∧ B.evs ≠ [] ∧ (B.moreRev = W64 0 ∧ B.evs = mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat
    st.minRev) hi ∨ ∃ M, B.moreRev = W64 ↑M ∧ sint.nat st.minRev < M ∧ M < hi ∧ B.evs =
    mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat st.minRev) M)

theorem mvcc.entsOfRev_range (r : Nat) (b : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.entsOfRev r
    b cs = List.filterMap (fun i => Option.map (fun kv => { rev := { main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑i
    }, tomb := (cs.getD i (mvcc.Change.del [])).isDel, kv := kv }) (mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑r) b cs i))
    (List.range cs.length)

theorem mvcc.changeKv_cases (r : w64) (b : List EtcdKv) (hb : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess b) (cs : List
    mvcc.Change) (i : Nat) (kv : EtcdKv) (h : mvcc.changeKv r b cs i = some kv) : (∃ k, cs[i]? =
    some (mvcc.Change.del k) ∧ kv = zeroKv k) ∨ ∃ k v l, cs[i]? = some (mvcc.Change.put k v l) ∧
    kv.modRev = r ∧ kv.createRev = (Option.map EtcdKv.createRev (mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.applyChanges r
    b (List.take i cs)))).getD r

theorem mvcc.combine_append_single (l : List w8) (b : w8) : LittleEndian.combine (l ++ [b]) =
    LittleEndian.combine l + BitVec.toNat b * 256 ^ l.length

theorem mvcc.logEvents_member_filter (C : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length C < 2 ^ 63) (r :
    mvcc.WatchRange) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (p : mvcc.EvM → Bool) (lo hi : Nat) (hp : ∀ (ev :
    mvcc.EvM), r.covers ev.kv.key = true → p ev = true) (hlo : ↑lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev) : List.filter
    (fun ev => r.covers ev.kv.key && decide (sint.Z st.minRev ≤ sint.Z ev.kv.modRev)) (List.filter p
    (mvcc.logEvents C lo hi)) = mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat st.minRev) hi

    ^ 64) : go.GoStringLt (mvcc.revBytes { main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑i } t) (mvcc.revBytes { main
    := W64 ↑hi, sub := W64 0 } false) ↔ r < hi

    ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (W : GMap Loc

theorem mvcc.sw_memberBatch_cases (C : mvcc.Log) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' C) (hlen : List.length C < 2 ^
    63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ C → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (W : GMap Loc
    mvcc.WatchRange) (P : mvcc.KvEnt → Bool) (c : Int) (minRev : Nat) (hP1 : ∀ (e : mvcc.KvEnt), e ∈
    mvcc.logEnts C minRev (List.length C) → c < sint.Z e.rev.main → P e = true) (hP2 : c = -1 ∨
    mvcc.oneChangePerKeyAt C c → ∀ (e : mvcc.KvEnt), e ∈ mvcc.logEnts C minRev (List.length C) → P e
    = true) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (lo : Nat) (hcov : ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM),
    r.covers ev.kv.key = true → mvcc.wgCovers W ev.kv.key = true) (hmin : ↑minRev ≤ sint.Z
    st.minRev) (hc : c ≤ sint.Z st.minRev) (hlo : ↑lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev) : mvcc.memberBatch r st
    (mvcc.entsEvents W (List.filter P (mvcc.logEnts C minRev (List.length C)))) = none ∧
    (mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat st.minRev) (List.length C) = [] ∨ ¬mvcc.api.onceUpTo C lo c) ∨ ∃
    B, mvcc.memberBatch r st (mvcc.entsEvents W (List.filter P (mvcc.logEnts C minRev (List.length
    C)))) = some B ∧ B.evs ≠ [] ∧ (B.moreRev = W64 0 ∧ (B.evs = mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat
    st.minRev) (List.length C) ∨ ¬mvcc.api.onceUpTo C lo c ∧ B.evs.Sublist (mvcc.watchEvents C r
    (sint.nat st.minRev) (List.length C))) ∨ ∃ M, B.moreRev = W64 ↑M ∧ sint.nat st.minRev < M ∧ M <
    List.length C ∧ (B.evs = mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat st.minRev) M ∨ ¬mvcc.api.onceUpTo C lo c
    ∧ B.evs.Sublist (mvcc.watchEvents C r (sint.nat st.minRev) M)))

    List.foldl (fun ob a => if q a = true then g ob a else ob) init l = List.foldl g init
    (List.filter q l)

    tb)

def mvcc.ebFold (F : List mvcc.EvM) : Option mvcc.EventBatch :=
  List.foldl (fun ob ev => some (mvcc.ebAdd (ob.getD mvcc.EventBatch.empty) ev)) none F

theorem mvcc.revBytes_lt_tomb (a : mvcc.Rev) : go.GoStringLt (mvcc.revBytes a false) (mvcc.revBytes
    a true)

def mvcc.CrPos (s : List EtcdKv) : Prop :=
  ∀ (kv : EtcdKv), kv ∈ s → kv.createRev ≠ W64 0

theorem mvcc.evsOfRevM_getD_rev (log : mvcc.Log) (j : Nat) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (hev : ev ∈
    mvcc.evsOfRevM j (mvcc.stateAt log (j - 1)) (List.getD log j [])) : j < List.length log ∧
    ev.kv.modRev = W64 ↑j

theorem mvcc.ebFold_spec_aux (n : Nat) (F : List mvcc.EvM) : F.length = n → mvcc.RevSorted F → F =
    [] ∧ mvcc.ebFold F = none ∨ F ≠ [] ∧ ∃ B, mvcc.ebFold F = some B ∧ mvcc.ebInv F B

theorem mvcc.beVal_u64Be (x : w64) : mvcc.beVal (u64Be x) = BitVec.toNat x

def mvcc.RevSorted (P : List mvcc.EvM) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise (fun a b => sint.Z a.kv.modRev ≤ sint.Z b.kv.modRev) P

theorem mvcc.beVal.eq_def (x✝ : List w8) : mvcc.beVal x✝ = match x✝ with | [] => 0 | a :: xs =>
    BitVec.toNat a * 256 ^ xs.length + mvcc.beVal xs

theorem mvcc.bucketMap_lookup_iff (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs :
    List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (k v : GoString) : mvcc.bucketMap log !! k =
    some v ↔ (k, v) ∈ mvcc.bucketOf log

theorem mvcc.revBytes_lt_main (a b : mvcc.Rev) (ta tb : Bool) (h : BitVec.toNat a.main <
    BitVec.toNat b.main) : go.GoStringLt (mvcc.revBytes a ta) (mvcc.revBytes b tb)

theorem mvcc.CrPos.stateAt (log : mvcc.Log) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^
    63) (n : Nat) : mvcc.CrPos (mvcc.stateAt log n)

theorem mvcc.bucketOf_logEnts (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.bucketOf log = List.map mvcc.KvEnt.pair
    (mvcc.logEnts log 0 (List.length log))

def mvcc.ebInv (P : List mvcc.EvM) (B : mvcc.EventBatch) : Prop :=
  B.moreRev = W64 0 ∧ B.evs = P ∧ 1 ≤ sint.Z B.revs ∧ sint.Z B.revs ≤ 1000 ∨
    sint.Z B.revs = 1001 ∧
      B.evs ≠ [] ∧
        ∃ ev,
          ev ∈ P ∧
            B.moreRev = ev.kv.modRev ∧
              (∀ (h : mvcc.EvM), P.head? = some h → sint.Z h.kv.modRev < sint.Z ev.kv.modRev) ∧
                B.evs = List.filter (fun e => decide (sint.Z e.kv.modRev < sint.Z ev.kv.modRev)) P

theorem mvcc.lex_append_left (p : List w8) {x y : List w8} : go.GoStringLt x y → go.GoStringLt (p ++
    x) (p ++ y)

theorem mvcc.logEvents_sorted (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (a b : Nat) :
    mvcc.RevSorted (mvcc.logEvents log a b)

theorem mvcc.CrPos.applyChange {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : mvcc.CrPos s) (r : w64) (hr : r ≠ W64 0) (c :
    mvcc.Change) : mvcc.CrPos (mvcc.applyChange r s c)

theorem mvcc.logEnts_entry (log : mvcc.Log) (a b : Nat) (e : mvcc.KvEnt) (he : e ∈ mvcc.logEnts log
    a b) : ∃ j i c kv, a ≤ j ∧ j < b ∧ j < List.length log ∧ log[j]? = some (List.getD log j []) ∧ e
    ∈ mvcc.entsOfRev j (mvcc.stateAt log (j - 1)) (List.getD log j []) ∧ (List.getD log j [])[i]? =
    some c ∧ mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑j) (mvcc.stateAt log (j - 1)) (List.getD log j []) i = some kv ∧ e
    = { rev := { main := W64 ↑j, sub := W64 ↑i }, tomb := c.isDel, kv := kv }

theorem mvcc.lex_prefix (x : List w8) (c : w8) (d : List w8) : go.GoStringLt x (x ++ c :: d)

theorem mvcc.ebInv_snoc (P : List mvcc.EvM) (x : mvcc.EvM) (B : mvcc.EventBatch) (hP : P ≠ []) (hs :
    mvcc.RevSorted (P ++ [x])) (h : mvcc.ebInv P B) : mvcc.ebInv (P ++ [x]) (mvcc.ebAdd B x)
